Odii, the audio guide service provider,\n tells interesting stories about the history and culture of Korean representative tourist spots.
Odii is an audio guide application that is developed by the Korea Tourism Organization.\nIt vividly delivers hidden stories of tourist spots for your pleasure and to smart travel.
With GPS services,\n it provides the audio guide contents of the tourist spots around you.
In addition to cultural tourism audio commentaries,\n it also provides various contents such as photos and scripts of tourist spots.
You can enjoy the contents without extra data charges if the content is downloaded with Wifi in advance.
There is a tourist spot in the vicinity of the foot painting event.\nParticipate right now and take prizes on site!

Odii Service only processes personal information for the following purposes and does not collect or store personal information separately.
 We always obtain the service users' prior consent in the event of a change in the purpose of use of their personal information.

 * Use of location information
 We process personal information in order to provide information on nearby recommended tourist sites based on the user's GPS location information.


* Use of background location information
 We use location-related data to provide push notification on Geofence-based "Stamp Events" even when the app is closed or not being used.


We do not collect or store personal information with which private individuals can be identified.
